caption: Extras are priced per switch: image migration $29, 301 redirects $29, out of stock quantities $19, prices with tax $39. We left all of them off; a vendor chat message is hidden.
The free demo migration moved both test products (2/2) before any payment was asked for.
The checkout for the full run: $29 for 2 products, extras $0, and the note This is one-time payment only. No tax line was shown and we did not pay.
The demo products arrived in Shopify as active products with inventory not tracked; the store name, also filled in as vendor, is hidden.
Removal goes through Shopify's standard uninstall, which asks the developer to delete customer data within 48 hours; the store and organization names are hidden.
